user.title: Llama Assist
user.description: Please create a unique prefix and choose what you want to add. You can use the same prefix for different engines.

conversation.title: Conversation Server
conversation.description: This server is used for generating responses (LLM). It must be OpenAI-compatible.

data.conversation-server-url: Conversation server URL (you might need to include /v1/ in the URL)
data.disable_reasoning: Disable model reasoning (will impact quality in favor of speed)
data.want_to_use_embeddings: Do you want to use embeddings?

embeddings.title: Embeddings Server
embeddings.description: This server is used for generating embeddings (vector representations of text). It must be OpenAI-compatible.

data.embeddings-server-url: Embeddings server URL (you might need to include /v1/ in the URL)
data.overwrite_embeddings: Always recalculate embeddings (slower but ensures up-to-date results)
data.use_embeddings_tools: Use embeddings to filter tools (improves speed)
data.use_embeddings_entities: Use embeddings to filter entities (improves speed)

tts.title: TTS Server
tts.description: This server is used for text-to-speech (TTS) generation. It must be OpenAI-compatible.

data.tts-server-url: TTS server URL (you might need to include /v1/ in the URL)

error.missing_prefix: You must provide a unique prefix for Llama Assist entities
error.entity_exists: An entity with this prefix already exists
error.missing_url: You must provide a URL for the server
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the server
